title: The Mirror-Corgi, Revisited — Boundary Grammar
creator: Feist, Jack
description: The Mirror-Corgi, Revisited — Boundary Grammar is a scholarly essay by Jack Feist, deposited 28 January 2026 at hex `00.PORTICO.AFTERLIFE.CORGI-REVISITED`, status CANONICAL. It returns to the AI-generated corgi video analysed at #1290 and #1293 and consolidates boundary grammar as a term: the rule set by which a generative system resolves what happens when a body meets a threshold. The revisiting is itself the method — a first analysis identifies a pattern, a second tests whether the pattern holds under re-examination, and the archive deposits both rather than replacing the first with the second.
